name: @pubshift/cli
description: Convert a whole folder of Microsoft Publisher files to PowerPoint, Word, PDF or SVG. Runs entirely on your own computer; nothing is uploaded.
//dependencies: Deliberately none. `node build.mjs` inlines @pubshift/core and its libraries into dist/, and copies the WebAssembly reader into vendor/, so an install pulls one tarball and needs no network, no compiler and no Homebrew.
